output.population: 609 adults aged 18-50 years without diabetes, BMI 28-40, randomized to a 12-month diet intervention.
output.intervention: Healthy low-fat diet delivered with behavior-modification sessions.
output.intervention_or_exposure: Healthy low-fat diet versus healthy low-carbohydrate diet.
output.comparator: Healthy low-carbohydrate diet delivered with the same behavioral framework.
output.outcome: 12-month body-weight change; interaction of diet with genotype pattern and baseline insulin secretion.
output.effect: Weight change at 12 months was -5.3 kg with healthy low-fat versus -6.0 kg with healthy low-carbohydrate diet; between-group difference 0.7 kg (95% CI -0.2 to 1.6). Diet-genotype interaction P=0.20 and diet-insulin-secretion interaction P=0.47.
output.applicability_boundary: Applies to adults aged 18-50 years with overweight/obesity but without diabetes; results concern the two healthy diet approaches as delivered in DIETFITS.
output.source_span: Weight change at 12 months was -5.3 kg for the HLF diet vs -6.0 kg for the HLC diet
